Name: Chicken Mask to Jacket's Mask (Content Patcher)
Author: Sourguppyworm
Description:
Simple retexture that turns the Chicken mask into Jacket's mask, Richard, from Payday 2/Hotline Miami
I also gave it a new description

I used the payday 2 mask for reference because i like it better

This should work fine on co-op too, I made it a retexture specifically so i could use it in co-op. The other player will need the mod to see it, but otherwise they should just see the chicken mask.

installation: extract the folder into your stardew valley/mods folder, requires content patcher.
